findings.text: the delta depends on a write grant the durable record does not carry. The run's recorded node.write_paths (read from its live pointer) and section 54's own list both name reckon/crew/dispatch_claims.py, reckon/crew/node.py, the test file and the fragment, and neither names reckon/crew/dispatch.py, which two of these five commits change. The grant lives only in the repair round's brief and in the manifest's scope_exception prose, so a later reader comparing the landed diff against the plan's declared write paths still sees a mismatch and crew check keeps reporting changed-paths-outside-the-write-scope until the record is widened. The work itself is the repair the earlier review asked for.

_pointer_can_meet re-implements the derivation-project choice that _scope_derivation_project (reckon/crew/dispatch_claims.py:180) owns: the project / preferred / mounted-first selection is keyed on the raw candidate repository root, where the owner keys on repository_identity(repository) through the identity cache. The comment at :276-284 names avoiding the probe as the reason, so the divergence is deliberate, but two lookups of one choice can drift, and a disagreement changes which derivation map expands the pointer's declared paths, which decides whether the pre-filter passes a claim over. The expansion itself still delegates to _expanded_scope_paths, so this is a partial duplication rather than a fork of the capability.

The earlier review's blocking finding was at reckon/crew/dispatch.py:1378 - the production dispatch passed no candidate paths, so the read narrowed only for a caller that did not exist. f0c2808fd answers it by deriving the node's own scope and handing it over; the pre-filter uses the same repository-and-containment test the refusal applies over the same _candidate_scope_entries set, so a claim the pre-filter drops is one the refusal could not refuse through either. Logs read: base-arm.log, head-arm-round2b.log, ruff-base.log, ruff-head.log, negative-control.log, mutation-scopes-view.log, mutation-scopes-view-restored.log. No figure was produced and section 54 names none.
